resolutions: Added a digest-excluded task-plan appendix that binds T3 to the four-file web-only scope and the completed T1/T2 flow.
Expanded required test leaves to cover mutation failure preservation, confirmed-state refetch, affected-query invalidation, and dialog accessibility/constrained layout.
current_flow: T1 exposes administrator-protected ZIP install and atomic complete-set attachment replacement routes, while T2 exposes a viewer-safe read-only Skills inventory/detail page; T3 adds only the missing administrator dialogs and query invalidation over those existing seams.

criteria_map.Administrators can choose one ZIP, see t: The ZIP-install leaf proves native file gating, application/zip submission, the always-visible approved warning, inventory-only installation, success actions, and Skills cache invalidation.
criteria_map.Administrators can replace the complete: The attachment and failure leaves prove lazy confirmed-state loading, complete-set PUT submission, open-dialog/input preservation, confirmed-state refetch after failure, and the next-run live announcement.
criteria_map.Disabled agents remain selectable and ar: The attachment leaf selects a disabled agent, asserts the exact approved label, and verifies its ID is included in the complete desired set.
criteria_map.Mutation flows invalidate Skills and aff: The role leaf proves viewer controls are absent; the mutation-failure/invalidation leaf proves Skills, navigation summary, and affected Agent queries are invalidated after success.
criteria_map.Dialog focus, keyboard operation, labels: The accessibility leaf explicitly proves labels, keyboard behavior, focus return, pending-close prevention, live status, and constrained responsive dialog dimensions using existing primitives.

new_abstractions: One scoped skills-admin-dialogs.tsx sibling component boundary; no generic abstraction or dependency.

rounds.question: The independent T3 grill passes with no remaining gaps. Should I hand off the exact four-file contract and five required tests for implementation?

citations.finding: The existing facade already provides the exact install and complete-set attachment endpoints, so T3 needs no backend expansion.
The approved spec requires disabled agents to remain selectable while attachment stays separate from action authorization.
The updated task appendix and required leaves close the prior handoff evidence gaps without changing the approved plan body.
